name: Clear Skies
description: Bright, calm weather that makes travel and foraging easier.

name: Heavy Rain
description: Continuous heavy rain reduces visibility and makes staying warm more difficult.

name: Dense Fog
description: Thick fog blankets the wilderness, making it easy to get lost.

name: Heat Wave
description: Oppressive heat increases thirst and makes physical activity exhausting.

name: Snowfall
description: Cold snow covers the ground, draining warmth and making travel slower.

name: Thunderstorm
description: Lightning and driving rain make open ground dangerous and rest difficult.
